title: Primitives Stewardship: Proposal & Review Checklist for Tokens, Primitives, and Charts
creator: Asha Patel
description: Purpose: Define a single, pragmatic checklist and proposal template for contributor-driven changes to core design primitives (color/spacing tokens, buttons, tables, chart components, and typography). Goal is to speed safe iteration while preventing regressions in downstream products.
background: We frequently get ad-hoc PRs that change token names, tweak component props, or introduce alternate chart types. Without a consistent intake and review bar, changes create silent regressions (visual drift, token collisions, downstream build breakage). This ticket codifies a lightweight stewardship flow that blends: (1) an RFC-style proposal artifact, (2) an engineering test matrix, (3) a design QA checklist, and (4) a staged deprecation path for removals/renames.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A published proposal template is available in the Design Confluence space. 2) A 9-point contributor checklist (design + eng + docs + accessibility) is added to PR templates. 3) Two pilot PRs (one token change, one chart enhancement) follow the flow and include required artifacts: visual diff screenshots, token migration guide, unit/visual tests, and a rollout plan. 4) Stakeholders (Design, Eng, PM) sign off on the checklist and it is linked from contribution docs.
proposal_template_summary: Required sections: summary, motivation, backward compatibility impact, UX examples, accessibility considerations, performance implications, migration path, test plan, rollout strategy, telemetry goals, owner and fallback. Submit as a Confluence page linked in PR description and RFC folder for long-running proposals.
pr_checklist: Design rationale included and screenshots for default & variants (light/dark/high contrast)
Token changes include both old->new mapping and codemod plan or alias layer
Visual regression screenshots for core pages (buttons, forms, tables, charts) at 3 breakpoints
Automated visual tests added (Chromatic or Percy) with baseline approved
Unit tests for any behavioral changes and Storybook examples updated
Accessibility audit: keyboard nav, color contrast, semantic roles and ARIA checks documented
Performance notes: any increased render cost or bundle size impact documented
Docs: Playground / migration guide / API surface documented in the Design System site
Rollout plan: canary flag, dependent repositories to update, rollback plan
rfc_thresholds: Minor: purely cosmetic token tweaks or internal-only variables — lightweight RFC (one-page) and 1 reviewer
Medium: public API change (component prop rename/behavior) — full RFC, cross-team review (Design, Eng, PM), 2-week comment period
Major: breaking token rename, removal, or new public contract for charts/tables — RFC + migration tools + 30-day deprecation timeline and announced release window
deprecation_policy: When removing or renaming primitives: 1) Owner files RFC describing reason and migration path. 2) Create a 3-release deprecation window: (a) Introduce aliasing shim and document migration; (b) Emit deprecation warnings in console/docs and add telemetry event; (c) Remove after window with migration guide updated to 'removed' status. For token renames the preferred approach is to keep old token as alias for at least two minor releases and provide a codemod in the PR.
rollback_and_emergency_runbook: If a merged change causes regressions in production dashboards or customer applications: 1) Tag a rollback hotfix branch and revert the merge. 2) Notify infra/eng on-call and product owners. 3) Open an incident note with root-cause and add a post-mortem link to the PR. 4) If rollback is not possible, push a compatibility shim and publish patch release. All incidents must log affected components and any customer-facing impact.
versioning_and_compat_strategy: Adopt a minor-release compatibility guarantee for tokens and components: patch releases may fix bugs, minor releases can add non-breaking props, major releases may remove deprecated APIs only after the deprecation window. Use feature flags for staged behavior and document compatibility matrix on the Design System site.
visual_testing_guidance: Add story variants for primary component axes (size, state, theme). Capture baseline for default app shells: Settings, Editor, Analytics. Use automated visual diff tooling and require failing diffs to be triaged before merge. For charts include sample datasets with edge cases (empty series, very large values, negative values).
accessibility_requirements: Every change must include an accessibility checklist: color contrast ratios (WCAG AA minimum for normal text), focus order validation, ARIA roles on interactive primitives, screen reader example for complex components (tables/charts). Document any exceptions in the RFC.
telemetry_and_monitoring: Proposals that change public behavior must add telemetry events for adoption and errors. For deprecations track usage of old tokens/APIs so we have data-driven retirement decisions. Expose a dashboard with token usage per repo and top-callers for new component props.
